verdict.rationale: Perplexity Sonar is an API product. Its public API is backed by rich first-party documentation: an API reference for the Sonar POST endpoint, quickstarts that get a key and a first call working in under 3 minutes, and official typed SDKs with sync and async clients. Independent probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, and the GitHub SDK corroborates programmatic usage, so every element of the story is covered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Generate an API key and make your first call in < 3 minutes.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The library includes type definitions for all request params and response fields, and offers both synchronous and asynchronous clients powered by httpx
For OpenAI SDK compatibility, `POST /v1/responses` is also accepted as an alias.
